verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI is an API-first service. It offers Python and TypeScript SDKs, a single-call HTTP transcription endpoint and a published OpenAPI spec, so it can be driven programmatically without any UI, which suits scripted and headless automation. The evidence never addresses CI pipelines specifically. Missing for 10: an official CLI, CI/CD-specific documentation or examples (e.g., non-interactive auth via environment variables, pipeline recipes), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Python or TypeScript SDK to integrate transcription, streaming, and voice agents directly into your own codebase.
The SDK uploads, submits, and polls for you in a single call.
in a single request-response call — no polling or webhooks needed.
